rows.abstract: Seeks to create a Head-Start Program to provide free essential supplies and medical support for newborns of indigent mothers. Proposes several components of the Program, among others, as follows: a) Free access to newborn screening; b) Provision of "Newborn Starter Kits" to all newborns of indigent mothers; c) Newborn care and nutrition seminars for parents; and d) Special support programs for indigent families, including supplemental nutrition and healthcare services.
